items.note: S2.3.1 states the (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) exchange with restored scratch for arbitrary initial values; the sub-steps follow the proof at 741-765 (net change (JV+RG)x, the bit and complex central coefficients, forward/inverse/forward composition). From L/N<1/2 to s<Wm in both networks, with the exact deficits eta_b=339/22587335000000 and eta_c=73/19906842167500, both >20*2^{-50}. With log m<20 this gives s/W<m^{1-2^{-50}}, the paper's route at 1331-1343.

The elementary-stream lemma (proof around 513-550) is only quoted, with no method. So the derivation covers only half of this item; I chose the conservative verdict.

The contract eq:finite-shear-contract, the cyclic row split (row Wg+(w-1) -> stream w), edge shears by recursive interchanges, the frame identity giving Phi_{I_m}, the merge undoing rho, the three-shear interchange, s calls on volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with the geometric sum, and the fixed-tape parking schedule. All as at 1491-1588.

Row field from the top rho=ceil(k log W/(2 log q)) digits of both chunks, zero-row padding to a multiple of W^k, base-m pieces summed geometrically using a_j<m and m^k<me, and numeric padding of binary ranges to [q^e]. This follows 1649-1734. The unequal-width remark (1740-1762) appears only later, in S3.2.7.

Conjugation by P_M with M extending the residual basis; one forward child per inverse kernel via (C^{-1})^{tensor f}=(-i)^f Z C Z; at most m(m-1)+3m row additions per basis change; exactly s_c children on slots of f chunks; and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D. Matches 1835-1940.

The derivation follows 2013-2207: the eight-line parity trick, packed cyclic shifts, the bad set from guard values, the union bound delta_bad, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting only B and repaired by sorting, the top position done separately, and the cost terms. S2.5.2's statement keeps only the asymptotic O(V(L^tau+1)) and drops the general bound eq:packed-rectangle-time and the conditions A_rect=O(p) and f<=d<=p (2004-2010).

Node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), rows from the first q_0 chunks padded to a multiple of W^{k_0}, children of volume exactly V/W, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves below d^{1/2}, the internal and leaf sums, and the base-m pieces giving O(d^{lambda'}). All as at 2286-2445.

States the layer with d=Theta(p^eps), K=floor(d^c), r=2^{Theta(p/d)}, output Q_p(Hz), error <sqrt2 2^{-p}, time O(Vd^{lambda'}). The proof route is followed: phase frames, packed calls meeting their family bounds, the guard width Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) with C_0=128mB^2 and A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, one exact evaluation, and a final truncation that keeps the disk.

Character cancellation without dividing, bit-reversed DIF output, the reversed recursion, rounds as a parallel butterfly plus a monomial, the prefix-slot moves O(TpdK), at most Dq-1 width-K chunk exchanges O(Tp pK^{tau-1}) defining L, the simultaneous-layer rounds, and one truncation per round giving error sqrt2 l 2^{-p}. Consistent with 2990-3128.

Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four products by the established multiplier, the separation |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2 with centered residues, negacyclic reduction, and truncation. Matches 3233-3366, including the carry ranges {-1,0} and {0,1}.

Two forward transforms kept in LB order, P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v), the opposite transform and the exact scale M, error sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}, and the cost including O(Tp log(rp)) for the pointwise products.

N=CTD near the identity (||N-I||<2^{-alpha^2 theta}<1/2), the left inverse D N^{-1} C, the normalizations to contractions A and B_0 (checked against 3615-3640), errors below p^2, both permutations kept, tensoring, and axis exposure with peeled bits. Matches the paper.

Periodicity of the chirp for even t_i, coefficient comparison for QF_t, F^+R=R^{-1}F^+ for unit dilations, R commuting with pointwise products, the two normalizations giving (u*v)/S^2, and conjugation for the opposite sign.

Phi is an isomorphism because the image of x has order S. The triangular digit formula, prefix-controlled rotations after axis reversal, preservation of zero padding, and the cost O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)) all match.

The source transform is A, then the computed chirp, then B_0, then 2^gamma, with exact counterpart RF_s and the opposite sign by conjugation. The six steps run: digits scaled by 2^{-b-2}, Phi, two transforms, pointwise product, opposite transform, scales S and 2^{2b+4}S, rounding, Phi^{-1}, carries. The two occurrences of S are explained.

The error chain E_ring<5TL, 6TL, 8TL, E_s=9 2^gamma TL, 3E_s+2, E_w<28 2^gamma T^2 L, then a final bound 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2 with disk margins at each call. Rounding and the carry invariant follow. All checked against 4582-4727.

Lists the seven normalized costs and their margins g_1..g_7 with min g_2=2^{-181}=2kappa. Setup and exceptional sorting are o(Tp), log factors are absorbed in p^kappa, and a schoolbook cutoff handles small n. This is the paper's route.

S1 states the eventual lower bound, that its negation needs liminf T_A/(n lg n)=0, and that a power saving gives limit zero. The paper gives no further derivation, so 'stated' is the most this item can reach.

errors.says: Splitting whole rows cyclically into a fixed number W of equal streams (and merging them back) takes O(V).
errors.paper: Lemma lem:elementary-streams item 4 splits whole rows cyclically into W streams and merges them only when W divides R; the streams are equal only under that divisibility, which the power-width proof secures separately with row counts divisible by W^k.

errors.says: The packed selected-bit addition runs in O(V(L^tau+1)) time when R exceeds every fixed polynomial in p and K/log p -> infinity.
errors.paper: The general bound is O(V(L^tau+1)+MA_rect^3+delta_bad MA_rect(R+A_rect)). It reduces to O(V(L^tau+1)) only under the further conditions A_rect=O(p) and f<=d<=p.

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route. Two fixed scalar networks with frames, subset labels and the rank budget give s<Wm and s/W<m^{1-2^{-50}}. Matrix shears turn edge ranks into recursive interchanges and phase kernels into child C-layers; the volume-normalized recurrences give O(Vu^tau) and O(Vd^{lambda'}). These feed synthetic transforms, Gaussian resampling with retained permutations, the chirp and cancellation identities, the CRT map, error tracking and the margin table. Nothing essential breaks. It is thinnest at the elementary stream lemma, which is only quoted, and at the packed-addition statement, which keeps only its asymptotic form.

steps.note: The fixed linear network exchanging banks (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored is stated and derived. h=100, v=C(100,3), N=v^3, m=h^3 and the triple-indexed data lines U_a appear in S2.3, S2.3.3.4 and S2.3.3.1.2.
A common invertible frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, so the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1}, and each edge costs only the frame change D_v D_u^{-1}.

Nondegenerate subspaces of F^{tensor 3} of dimension m, comparable labels on every edge, and the only decreasing edges at center 3->4, each losing h. All are stated with the forms that make neighbouring lines orthogonal.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested nondegenerate labels, and the N source edges 2P_{U_a} as rank-one exceptions.
The sum of |Delta dim| equals Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, obtained by telescoping and the terminal sums, and then s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L/N=100/539 and 101/539 are both below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b>0 (and 2N-2L_c>0) and s<Wm.
M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role (P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m for X_a, 0 to I elsewhere), so the bit network applies H<-H+D on every role, including scratch rows.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, a shear by a rank-a matrix in exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and the recursive calls per node totalling s.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, giving F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the whole central chain with its defining quantities. The fixed bank-exchange network and its frames come first. Subset labels give the budget Wm-2N+2L with L/N<1/2, so s<Wm. The endpoint identity yields the shear H<-H+D, edge ranks become recursive interchanges, and the normalized recurrence with s/W<m^{1-2^{-50}} gives O(e^tau).
